note: 36 cases. Priced (26): 15 clean, 3 bundle (EUR 3-per-category rule not spelled out), 5 Germany with an unknown or ambiguous HS code, 3 non-blender products. Must not guess (10): 5 missing inputs, 2 above EUR 150, 2 US without a confirmed code, 1 unsupported market. Priced cases state all commercial assumptions so the baseline is not penalised for unknown demo values. Ground truth = sourced rules applied by landed.engine.

cases.prompt: 500ml portable blender, ships alone. Motor built into the product, no heating, household use, HS 8509.40 (confirmed by me). Unit cost ¥38, shipping weight 0.6 kg. What list price should I charge in Germany for a 25% margin? Assume: sold B2C to consumers in Germany via IOSS; platform fee 15% of the VAT-inclusive price; freight ¥45/kg; 8% of units are returned and written off (their COGS, freight and duty are lost); FX 8.25 CNY per EUR. Margin = profit ÷ revenue excluding VAT.
